description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Training Grounds, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Aunt May and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
